prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, home layout, home new_screen, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns and sign-in hints were helpful, generating multiple winning tests.
Home waiting info and home notifications proved helpful by yielding winning tests, though several tests showed no clear effect.
Copy changes on path selection (choose_path copy) and finish screens (finish copy), along with adding new finish screens (finish new_screen), consistently hurt performance.
Home redesigns, home hints, finish hints, choose_path layouts, and finish redesigns consistently showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but underestimated unexpected winning layout, hint, and wait info changes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] List layout redesign for photo upload screen: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a step-by-step list layout to clearly guide photo selection. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong; a structured list layout clarifies inputs.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for friend selection screen: Redesign the pet friend selection screen using an immersive full-bleed layout to feature pet options prominently. (why: Adoption layout redesigns are proven winners in early tests, and full bleed format enhances pet visibility during selection.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Grid layout redesign for sign-in screen: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured grid layout to present sign-in and recovery options cleanly. (why: 10 support emails reported sign-in stalls or missing pets after sign-in; grid layout improves option clarity.)
3: [adoption, redesign] List layout redesign for adoption certificate screen: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a list layout to present pet attributes line by line. (why: Adoption redesigns generated multiple winning tests in prior weeks and list layout provides clean readability.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after photo upload screen: Move sign-in to appear immediately after the photo upload step in the adoption flow. (why: Placing sign-in right after pet creation lets users invest effort in their custom pet before committing to sign-in.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign-in account recovery guidance hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reminding users that signing in with their original account email restores saved pets. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo lighting advice hint on upload screen: Display a hint on the photo upload screen advising users to upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
7: [home, wait_info] Time estimate display on waiting screen: Enable the estimated remaining time display on the desktop loading waiting screen. (why: Home waiting info changes yielded winning tests, setting expectations for long load times (median 201s).)
8: [home, wait_info] Step counter progress display on waiting screen: Enable the step counter on the waiting screen to give progress feedback during desktop pet initialization. (why: 3 users reported desktop pet launch confusion, and home waiting step information has proven beneficial.)
9: [sign_in, incentive] Sign-in mascot encourage element: Add a mascot companion graphic on the sign-in screen encouraging users as they connect their account. (why: Sign-in conversion is 88.7%; friendly visual cues reduce anxiety over potential account stalls or loss.)
